meta.title: Statutory clocks for IM40 import (YuklaGo deadline engine)

sources_read.doc: Customs Code of the Republic of Uzbekistan (O'RQ-400, 20.01.2016)

sources_read.read: lex.uz shows future editions dated 30.12.2026 and 05.02.2027 – re-check 227¹⁰/227²⁶ before those dates ⚠️

meta.calendar_rule_summary: All Customs Code import clocks here are in CALENDAR days unless marked working_day. Only Art. 261 (filing) has an explicit non-working-day shift (to the customs body's next working day). The Code has no general term-calculation article; for other clocks no shift is stated ⚠️.
meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. Re-check lex.uz before each release; amendments are frequent.

clocks.rule: Authorised persons MUST submit advance information on goods and vehicles expected by road, rail and air through the Internet into the customs information system before they actually arrive; they are liable for its accuracy.
clocks.uncertain: Minimum lead time (hours before arrival) and the exact system/format are not stated in the Code ⚠️. Prior lesson (dars-01) cited Art. 17 as 'right, not duty' – Art. 206 part 3 makes it mandatory for road/rail/air; reconcile.

clocks.rule: For goods entering the territory, the transit declaration is filed before or at the moment of crossing the customs border.

clocks.start_event: delivery of goods to the destination customs body (or start of its working hours if delivered outside them)
clocks.rule: Carrier notifies the destination customs body by presenting accompanying documents and the goods, no later than 30 minutes after delivery; if delivered outside working hours, no later than 30 minutes after working hours start (goods wait in the customs control zone).

Destination customs body confirms delivery within 3 hours by marking the accompanying documents (suspended if an offence is found). From the moment of confirmation the goods have the status of goods under the temporary-storage regime.
clocks.product_note: This confirmation timestamp is the best machine-readable start for the temporary-storage clock.

clocks.start_event: day goods are presented to the customs body
clocks.rule: Short cargo customs declaration is filed by the carrier or other authorised person no later than the working day following the day of presentation; not needed if the goods are placed under another regime within that time.

related.ref: VMQ No. 605 Regulation, clause 10: if goods stay under constant customs control and clearance finishes within 24 hours after hand-over, temporary storage is not applied as a separate stage

clocks.start_event: day goods acquire temporary-storage status (= delivery confirmation, Art. 226)
clocks.rule: Period is set by the authorised person who declared the regime but may not exceed 60 calendar days (10 calendar days for perishable goods) unless the Code provides otherwise (Art. 177 – liquidated warehouses: 60/180 days). Count starts from the day the goods acquired temporary-storage status (Art. 85 part 4 referring to Art. 177 and Art. 226 part 5). Goods must be declared for another regime no later than the day the period ends (Art. 89 part 1) and removed from the storage place within 3 days after placement under the other regime (Art. 89 part 2).
clocks.storage_fee_note: Storage in a customs-body warehouse is charged per VM No. 55 (3% of BHM per tonne per day for the first 10 days, then 4% – per dars-01; see data/tariff/fees.json).
clocks.uncertain: Whether the 15-day filing clock and the 60-day storage clock run in parallel from the same day for goods under temporary storage (practice: the stricter 15-day clock governs the import GTD) ⚠️.

clocks.start_event: day goods are presented to the destination customs body
clocks.rule: Declaration for imported goods is filed no later than 15 calendar days from the day the goods were presented to the destination customs body, except cases in Chapters 22 (commercial vehicles), 23 (individuals, non-commercial) and 25 (pipeline / power lines). If the last day falls on a day the customs body does not work, the next working day of that customs body is the last day.
clocks.quote_uz: …товар келиб тушадиган божхона органига товарлар тақдим этилган кундан эътиборан ўн беш календарь кундан кечиктирмай берилади… Агар … муддатининг тугаши божхона органи ишламайдиган кунга тўғри келиб қолса, божхона органининг навбатдаги иш куни шу муддат тугайдиган кун деб ҳисобланади.

start_day_rule.text_says: 'from the day of presentation' (кундан эътиборан); calendar days; end on non-working day of the customs body → next working day of that body.
start_day_rule.general_counting_article_in_customs_code: None found – the Customs Code has no general article on calculating periods (searched the full text 2026-11-18). Only Art. 261 part 2 covers the non-working-day shift for this deadline.

civil_code_analogy.ref: Civil Code Art. 146 (a period defined by a span of time starts on the day after the calendar date or event that marks its start); Art. 148 (an action may be done until 24:00 of the last day; in an organisation – until its working hours end; filings handed in before 24:00 count as on time)
civil_code_analogy.status: Applies to civil-law periods; whether it governs Customs Code periods is NOT confirmed ⚠️.

start_day_rule.product_rule_PROPOSAL: Show the conservative date (presentation day = day 1 → presentation + 14 days, shifted past non-working days) as the 'file by' date; show presentation + 15 days (shifted) as 'legal maximum (interpretation)'. Remind at T-5, T-2, T-1. Treat 'end of day' as the post's working hours end, not 24:00, until confirmed (Civil Code Art. 148 part 2 analogy).

reading_B_next_day_start.method: count starts next day (Civil Code Art. 146 analogy)

examples.note: Shift assumes the post does not work Sat/Sun; real schedule and public holidays must come from a maintained calendar.

reading_B_next_day_start.method: count starts next day (Civil Code Art. 146 analogy)

examples.note: Shift assumes the post does not work Sat/Sun; real schedule and public holidays must come from a maintained calendar.

fines.text: Failure to submit the customs declaration, documents or additional information within the established periods → fine of 3 × BHM (BHM = 440,000 UZS from 01.09.2026 → 1,320,000 UZS).
Repeated within one year after the penalty → citizens 5–10 × BHM, officials 10–15 × BHM.
Breach of declaration procedure (form, place, procedure) → citizens 2–5 × BHM, officials 3–7 × BHM.

clocks.start_event: day the preliminary declaration is accepted
clocks.rule: Optional declaring before goods arrive. If the goods are not presented to the customs body within 30 calendar days from acceptance, the preliminary declaration is deemed not filed. After comparison of copies with originals and payment (or security) before arrival, it is the single document for customs operations (unless data/documents incomplete).

incentive.ref: VM No. 55, Annex 1, note '*': 20% discount on the customs fee for preliminary declaration; fee charged once

PF-250 of 17.12.2025, item 2: from 01.03.2026 for IM40 via preliminary declaration before arrival at the border crossing point – clearance fee −20%; no interest for up to 14 days on instalment/deferral

clocks.rule: Acceptance is registered on the day of filing (Art. 264). E-system: an officer accepts the TED within 3 hours of receipt, otherwise it is accepted automatically (VMQ 605 Annex 1, stage 4). TED counts as accepted from the moment the e-notification is sent (VMQ 605 clause 15). The acceptance date fixes rates (Art. 324) and the exchange rate (Art. 326).

Low risk, no amendments: 3 hours; medium risk, no amendments: 8 hours (except TED filed outside working hours); high risk or other cases: general term in law. General term (Code Art. 248 part 4): clearance and document check within one working day from the day the declaration is accepted and all documents/data are presented (extended for risk-management measures).

Customs payments are paid before or simultaneously with acceptance of the declaration (exceptions in Art. 327). With deferral/instalments – by the last day of deferral / per the agreed schedule (Arts. 327, 333).

late_consequences.text: Penalty (penya) for each calendar day of non-payment: 1/300 of the CBU refinancing rate on the debt; total penya ≤ the debt; runs from the day the debt arises to the day actually paid.
Non-payment within established periods → citizens 3–7 × BHM, officials 5–10 × BHM.

clocks.gtd_field: grafa 47 'СП' codes ОП/РП and grafa 48 for deferral/instalments (Instruction 2773)

clocks.start_event: day goods were placed under another regime
clocks.rule: Goods must leave the temporary-storage place within three days (unit 'days' – calendar vs working not stated ⚠️) after placement under another regime, except customs-warehouse regime.

After clearance, the GTD may be amended, supplemented, re-issued or cancelled within 3 years from acceptance at customs' request or on application; withdrawal before release if reasons accepted. E-GTD changes via a correction form. Fee for declarant-initiated amendment per VM 55 (25% of BHM per correction form – per dars-01).

legal_basis.ref: VMQ No. 605 Regulation, clause 30 (right to request amendment when quantity/description discrepancies are found during or after unloading)

clocks.start_event: year after the year in which goods lost the status of goods under customs control
clocks.rule: Customs declaration and other documents needed for customs control are kept for three years from the year following the year in which the goods lost the status of goods under customs control.
Customs may audit after release (Art. 201) and charge additional payments (Art. 294) – informational.
